notes:
v1.6.8 (Android): Seamless YouTube-to-movie stream transitions. Fixed player getting stuck in pause state when transitioning between web streams and direct video streams.
v1.6.7 (Android): Hardware decoder stability & multi-tier adaptive speed nudging. Completely resolves periodic video freezes on Fire TV / Android TV by replacing hard decoder seeks with smooth 1.02x-1.12x rate adjustments.
v1.6.6 (Android): Playback lead-time fix — lead time only applies when joining mid-video, clean YouTube start and improved player watchdog. Both APKs signed with official production RSA-4096 release key.
v1.6.5 (Android): WebP asset optimization — APK size reduced by nearly 50% from 37 MB to 20.3 MB. Native update feed migrated to GitHub Releases.
v1.6.4 (Android): Persistent chat account login & guest access, fullscreen chat mode for mobile/tablets, and responsive layout polish.
